name: task-manager
description: Task management web app — Express + MySQL (server) and React + Vite + TailwindCSS (client)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n SERVER,CLIENT -c green,cyan "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
